messages.content: How do I connect a MultispeQ to the openJII mobile app? Cite the guide and page you used.

arguments.query: connect MultispeQ to openJII mobile app

outputs.answer:
To connect a MultispeQ to the openJII mobile app, pair the device over Bluetooth Classic on your Android phone, then select it from the device picker within the app.  

This procedure is detailed in the guide titled ["Connect a MultispeQ"](https://openjii.org/devices/multispeq/connect), page 4.
